newsitem.title: INDIA: India MICO to set up auto part plant.
newsitem.headline: India MICO to set up auto part plant.

text.p: The government of the northwestern Indian state of Rajasthan said on Friday it signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with MICO Ltd, a member of Germany's Bosch group, to set up an auto ancillary project.

The project, estimated to cost 2.5 billion rupees ($70 million) would be set up at the state's Sitapura Industrial Area on a 50-acre plot, the state's Bureau of Industrial Promotion (BIP) said in a statement.
"MICO will set up the unit to manufacture fuel injection systems for motor vehicles in view of a growing demand for its products from the automotive sector," the statement said.
"The factory is expected to become operational by 1998," it said.
